explanation: Scholars had known the Earth was round since ancient Greece. Columbus's critics argued, correctly, that he had badly underestimated its size and the distance west to Asia.

claims.text: Educated Europeans of the late 1400s knew that the Earth is round.
Ancient Greek scholars established that the Earth is a sphere.
Columbus's critics objected that he had underestimated the size of the Earth and the distance westward to Asia.
